column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Cush” is rendered “Ethiopia,” and “will make her hands run” as “will quickly stretch out her hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He gives with His voice” is rendered “He speaks forth with His voice.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the clouds” is rendered “the skies.”
“God is awesome from Your sanctuaries” is rendered “O God, You are awesome from Your sanctuary.”
